module_summary: Four-state Moore FSM with async-reset state register and case-based next-state logic on in, asserting out in state D.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 2-bit Moore state register A-D, async reset to A, decoded into out.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output high only in state D.
